name: agri-governance-ai
description: Multimodal AI platform for crop health diagnostics, market intelligence, government scheme retrieval, and public-policy analytics for Indian agriculture

paragraphs: Multimodal AI platform for crop health diagnostics, market intelligence, government scheme retrieval, and public-policy analytics — built for Indian agriculture.
AgriGovernance AI is an end-to-end agricultural intelligence platform that combines computer vision, time-series forecasting, TF-IDF retrieval, and risk scoring to serve two primary audiences:
The entire MVP runs on deterministic, interpretable models — no black-box ML required — making it auditable, debuggable, and deployable anywhere without a GPU.
features: Crop disease screening — pixel-level heuristics (yellowing, necrosis, dark spots, pale stress) on uploaded leaf images
Market intelligence — local linear trend forecasting with 4-week price band projections and volatility signals
Scheme retrieval — TF-IDF scheme index ranked by crop × state relevance with eligibility details
District risk score — composite index across weather, soil nutrients, market volatility, and grievance load
Personalized advisory — plain-language action plan combining all signals
